observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
set -e
# 1. fresh bootstrap login start
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -D s2.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8080/admin/login/start?mode=bootstrap" -o /dev/null
AUTH_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' s2.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
rm -f dex_cookies.txt
# 2. dex login form
curl -s -c dex_cookies.txt --max-time 10 -L "$AUTH_URL" -o dexform2.html -w "dex form: [%{http_code}]\n"
FORM_ACTION=$(grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' dexform2.html | head -1 | sed 's/action="//;s/"//' | sed 's/&/\&/g')
# 3. dex login as kai
curl -s -b dex_cookies.txt -c dex_cookies.txt \
  --data-urlencode "login=kai@example.com" --data-urlencode "password=changeme" \
  -D dexh2.txt -o /dev/null -e "http://dex:5556${FORM_ACTION}" "http://dex:5556${FORM_ACTION}"
CB_URL=$(grep -i '^location:' dexh2.txt | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^[Ll]ocation: //')
echo "CB_URL: $CB_URL" | cut -c1-90
# 4. admin callback (ONE request - captures 302 to select-claim)
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -D cbh2.txt --max-time 20 "$CB_URL" -o cb2_body.html
grep -i '^HTTP\|^location' cbh2.txt
echo "$CB_URL" > cb2_url.txt
